Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 9232 total shipments / 84 partners; only 4 dated export rows + 1 import row were visible in the free view (rest paywalled) — counter far exceeds visible rows, so the 9232 figure is a platform counter, not independently counted.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403; company site rajpetro.com failed with TLS error. ImportKey does show the company as a buyer/importer of base oil from SHELL LUBRICANTS SUPPLY CO BV ("2026-02-25 SHELL LUBRICANTS SUPPLY CO BV RAJ PETRO SPECIALITIES PRIVATE LIMITED BASE OIL SHELL XHVI 3 IN BULK ... Ras Laffan, QATAR MUMBAI CUSTOM HOUSE SEA INBOM1, India 27101971 7740640") and S-OIL CORPORATION (2881 shipments), which evidences an operating refinery/blending plant in India but is not a domestic-sales record. Domestic supply therefore: not confirmed, not denied — unknown.
note: Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code (Hong Kong, Egypt, Sri Lanka, Korea), so this is not a 'declared only' case. Declared HS 382499 does not match the observed export HS codes (27101986 light liquid paraffin, 27121090 petroleum jelly, 27129090 wax) — per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actual codes (2710/2712 family). Revenue and export volume: null — no public figures found, not estimated. Note the two address variants (No:73/1B Vaikkadu Village, Manali, Chennai-600 103 and 1st Flr, 124 G.D. Ambekar Marg, Ambawadi, Cotton [Market], Mumbai) appear under the same name; whether these are one legal entity with a Mumbai office or two distinct registrations could not be verified from public sources. No sanctions/court/ownership checks were performed (out of scope for this role).
